execution_context.basis: Recorded tool launch and resume boundary, before post-hoc grading
execution_context.interpretation: Any pair straddling the context boundary is not a clean paired timing or causal-quality comparison. Keep it descriptive, without rerunning either arm.

interruption.observed_error: PermissionError: Operation not permitted in os.killpg during guard cleanup
interruption.response: Paused controller with SIGINT; bounded in-flight guard completed; verified no surviving R4 worker before resume.
interruption.result: No final artifact published; no retry. Unknown solver outcome.

limitations: Primary synthetic cases, development repeats, historical diagnostics and controls are separate strata.
Repeated request seeds are not automatically independent engine seeds.
Missing/timeout output is unknown quality, never a zero-accuracy score.
Saved-text maxima are post-hoc diagnostics, not exhaustive generated-menu quality or a selectable oracle.
Historical scores use unreviewed frozen references; no source/repair conclusions until R3 review.
No provider verification or live-agent advantage was measured.
The sandbox-to-host cleanup change is recorded; any boundary-straddling pair is descriptive, not a clean causal/timing comparison.
